fullPassage: Famadihana is a unique ritual practiced by the people of Madagascar to celebrate their ancestors. It is a festival held once every seven years. During the celebration, a Malagasy family enters the tombs of its ancestors and brings out their bones to be wrapped in fresh cloth. Following this, music is played, and people dance with the remains of their dead relatives. The people of Madagascar believe that humans are not made from dust, but from the bodies of their ancestors. They show great respect to human bodies because they are considered gifts from their forefathers. They also believe that the dead remain in the world until their bodies break down completely. Until this happens, the dead are able to receive and enjoy the love shown to them during Famadihana.

During the celebration, a Malagasy family enters the tombs of its ancestors and brings out their bones to be wrapped in fresh cloth. Following this, music is played, and people dance with the remains of their dead relatives. The people of Madagascar believe that humans are not made from dust, but from the bodies of their ancestors. They show great respect to human bodies because they are __________. They also believe that the dead remain in the world until their bodies break down completely. Until this happens, the dead are able to receive and enjoy the love shown to them during Famadihana.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시신에 큰 존경을 보이는 이유는 그것이 '조상이 준 선물로 여겨지기(considered gifts from their forefathers)' 때문이라는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① hidden away from visitors — 방문객에게서 숨겨진 (문맥 무관)
✅ ② considered gifts from their forefathers — 조상이 준 선물로 여겨지는 ←정답
❌ ③ sold to foreign museums — 외국 박물관에 팔린 (문맥 무관)
❌ ④ destroyed after the festival — 축제 후 파괴되는 (존경한다는 내용과 반대)
det.tip: respect ~ because they are considered gifts = 선물로 여겨지기 때문에 존경
